title: The parity gap in crystal tensor prediction
summary: Crystal symmetry dictates whether a physical response tensor must vanish, establishing a direct test for machine learning predictions independent of property calculations. We derive the parity gap, a group-theoretic metric quantifying the piezoelectric tensor freedom permitted by a crystal's proper rotation subgroup $SO(3)$ but eliminated by inversion symmetry in $O(3)$.
